[Contest] Unleash your kinky creativity!
notes.content:
Calling all Maniacs!

It’s time to let your imagination roam free and win some tasty treats!
Check out the prompt below, and continue the story and we’ll award the most original storyteller with awesome ingame prizes!
 
Prompt:
[i][b]Once upon a time, a nymph called Carnival fell in love on the dance floor. She never thought she’d love anything more than dancing, but as she got lost in the rhythm, someone peaked her interest…

What happens next? You decide![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39317549/f232c349b5d793bc546e35e1acc77a1624bb1e31.png[/img]

[b]How this works: [/b]
[list]
[*] Drop a comment in this post and continue the prompt with what you think happens next.
[*] The story should include at least one Merge Nymphs character, and be no longer than 10 sentences (of any length). 
[*] The lucky winner will be chosen randomly and will receive an ingame prize of 700 rubies 
[*] One random player will be chosen at the end of the contest period. In order to receive the prize, you will have to provide your Steam ID (17-digit number) in the same comment as your submission. 
[*] The quiz will be available between 10th - 16th of May
[*] The winner will be announced on 17th of May
[/list]

Don’t miss out! 

Love,
The Merge Nymphs team
